# Crumbs CSS 1.0.0

The first stable release of `@opsydyn/crumbs-css` is available on npm as `latest`.

```sh
npm install @opsydyn/crumbs-css@1.0.0
```

Typed native styles, component recipes, atomic Sprinkles, scoped tokens, native conditions, local variables, container conditions, Animated motion, colour/typography algebra, and typed runtime factories with explicit runtime imports are included. Design-system tooling covers manifests, compatibility, policy, migrations, DTCG import, ownership and explanations. Effect 4 is an internal dependency; applications use ordinary Crumbs and React APIs.

Read the [quickstart and complete API index](https://github.com/opsydyn/crumbs-css#get-started), [documentation](https://opsydyn.github.io/crumbs-css/), and [release notes](https://github.com/opsydyn/crumbs-css/blob/main/docs/releases/1.0.0.md). The supported consumer baseline is Expo 56, React 19.2 and React Native 0.85; tooling requires Node >=22.0.0. Stable APIs follow SemVer and documented deprecation before major removal.

The [guarded publisher](https://github.com/opsydyn/crumbs-css/actions/runs/38066766715) rebuilt immutable source `382768a45f429f4c039e7584cd7c31e4f8821fc0` and reproduced the exact approved tarball SHA-256 `0cdbdb65f89c875e8376fb3dfff749fbd7190416170f93e3855b47ac705b2b50`. Independent public-registry integrity, cryptographic npm provenance and a fresh installed consumer all pass, including strict types and iOS/Android/web exports. The v1 tag is unchanged.

The complete retained 21-row host report keeps its numerical results. Cold transform and all eight editor rows pass. Warm transform and the 0.174 ms incremental overrun have explicit, bounded v1-only release approval; eight advisory rows remain failed. Numerical limits, baselines and generic future-release gates are unchanged. See the [publication evidence](https://github.com/opsydyn/crumbs-css/blob/main/docs/evidence/2026-10-10-v1-publication/README.md).

Physical devices, spoken readers, release FPS and other unperformed acceptance contexts remain deferred; M11.6 integrations remain parked. The immutable package README retains its prepublication snapshot and links the current release-status page; current onboarding lives in the links above.
